  - **M374g** Papalymo's forbidden magick swallows him and seals the primal in a cocoon of light. *Griffin, Griffin on the Wall* (3.5, main): "the incantation swallows Papalymo and encases the newborn entity in a vast cocoon of light."
  - **M375a** Alphinaud breaks the news of Papalymo's passing. *Louisoix's Finest Student* (3.5, main): "Alphinaud finally breaks the news of [[Papalymo]]'s passing."
  - **M375b** Ilberd's primal will not be contained forever. *Louisoix's Finest Student* (3.5, main): "the [[primal]] summoned by [[Ilberd]] will not be contained forever..."
  - **M375c** Y'shtola and Krile will inspect the cocoon. *Louisoix's Finest Student* (3.5, main): "We must inspect the cocoon of light, and ascertain the state of the primal trapped within."
  - **M375d** No one knows yet how Ilberd came by Nidhogg's eyes. *Louisoix's Finest Student* (3.5, main): "I have as yet been unable to explain how Ilberd came to possess Nidhogg's eyes."
  - **M375f** Alphinaud calls for preparations to face Ilberd's creation. *Louisoix's Finest Student* (3.5, main): "We must begin preparations to face Ilberd's accursed creation without delay."

</details>

### Waking Omega (`evt-waking-omega`, event)

**#376 only · main**

> The primal Ilberd summoned waits in a cocoon of light above the Wall, sealed by Papalymo's sacrifice; a Garlean airship that approached was destroyed. Nero, a former tribunus who studied beside Cid, offered the Alliance council Omega, an Allagan weapon beneath Carteneau, and the council sent Cid's contingent to take command of it. Alphinaud wonders how Nero learned of the meeting.

Sources shown: Griffin, Griffin on the Wall — main scenario quest (3.5); The Obvious Solution — main scenario quest (3.56)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M374g** Papalymo's forbidden magick swallows him and seals the primal in a cocoon of light. *Griffin, Griffin on the Wall* (3.5, main): "the incantation swallows Papalymo and encases the newborn entity in a vast cocoon of light."
  - **M376a** Y'shtola has confirmed a primal in the cocoon. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "Archon Y'shtola has confirmed the presence of a primal entity..."
  - **M376b** A Garlean airship that approached the cocoon was destroyed. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "A Garlean airship was observed making an approach, but the vessel was destroyed when it drew near."
  - **M376c** Nero, a former tribunus of the XIVth Legion, proposes Omega against the primal. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "Nero tol Scaeva, former tribunus of the XIVth Legion of the Garlean Empire. … I speak, of course, of Omega."
  - **M376e** Nero studied beside Cid at the Academy. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "All those years studying side by side at the Academy, sharing both trial and triumph."
  - **M376f** Omega has lain beneath Carteneau since the Allagans. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "That hulk has been gathering dust beneath the plains of Carteneau since the Allagans breathed their last!"
  - **M376g** The council sends a contingent to Carteneau to take command of Omega. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "Let the records show that we invest this contingent with the authority to enter Carteneau and take command of Omega."
  - **M376i** Alphinaud wonders how Nero learned of the council meeting. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "not least among them how Nero chanced to learn of the council meeting in the first place."

</details>

**#377 only · main**

> The Alliance sent Cid's contingent, with Nero, to wake Omega beneath Carteneau against the primal in the cocoon, and Alisaie insists Nero never leave her sight. Gosetsu brought word that Doma calls Yugiri home, but she stays to face the crisis, and Gosetsu joins the expedition. Tataru sewed you an outfit with a charm to bring you home.

Sources shown: The Obvious Solution — main scenario quest (3.56); The Greater Obeisance — main scenario quest (3.56)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M376g** The council sends a contingent to Carteneau to take command of Omega. *The Obvious Solution* (3.56, main): "Let the records show that we invest this contingent with the authority to enter Carteneau and take command of Omega."
  - **M377a** Alisaie insists Nero never leave her sight. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "your sister was adamant that he would never leave her sight."
  - **M377b** Gosetsu brings word that his master is in peril and Doma calls Yugiri home. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "Our master languishes in dire peril, and Doma calls her daughter home!"
  - **M377e** Yugiri stays to play her part in the crisis. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "A crisis threatens all within this realm, Eorzean and Doman alike, and I go to play my part in its resolution."
  - **M377f** Gosetsu's blade is oathbound against the imperials. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "My blade is oathbound to fall upon the ranks of the imperials wheresoever they march!"
  - **M377g** Tataru sews a blood pearl charm into your new outfit. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "I also sewed in a blood pearl charm to...you know...bring you home."
  - **M377h** The Omega contingent assembles at the airship landing. *The Greater Obeisance* (3.56, main): "the [[Omega]] contingent is assembling at the [[airship]] landing."

</details>

**#378 only · main**

> In Carteneau, Cid and Nero roused Omega while you, Yda and the Domans held off an imperial attack. Omega was expected to seek out the primal at the Wall. Yda launched it for Papalymo's sake; then its signal fell silent and Cid reengaged its stasis, and Papalymo's spell, bound to his aether, is fading.

Sources shown: Fly Free, My Pretty — main scenario quest (3.56)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M378a** Cid and Nero will rouse Omega while you, Yda and the Domans keep watch. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "Nero and I will focus on rousing Omega, while"
  - **M378c** An imperial officer, Grynewaht, calls Cid a traitor. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "I chase down a suspect airship, and who should I find but the traitor"
  - **M378d** Omega is expected to seek out and capture the primal at the Wall. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "Once we release Omega, we can be fairly certain it will attempt to capture the primal at Baelsar's Wall."
  - **M378e** Yda launches Omega for Papalymo's sake. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "You gave too much for us to waste this chance, Papalymo. So this is for you...and me."
  - **M378f** Omega's signal falls silent, and Cid reengages its stasis. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "the signal emanating from the weapon falls silent, prompting Cid to reengage its stasis systems."
  - **M378g** Papalymo's spell, bound to his aether, is fading. *Fly Free, My Pretty* (3.56, main): "Papalymo's spell is fading. It was bound to his aether, you see...and if the connection is broken..."

</details>

**3.56 onward · main**

> Omega reached the cocoon as it hatched, and a great dragon the Domans call Shinryu rose from it; the two fought over Gyr Abania and fell together onto Ala Mhigan soil. The Alliance has taken the Wall, and Ser Aymeric proposes contacting the Resistance. Yda revealed she is Lyse, sister of the true Yda, who died six years ago, and she will carry on her family's fight for Ala Mhigo. In Ala Mhigo, an imperial Viceroy expects interesting days.

Sources shown: The Far Edge of Fate — main scenario quest (3.56)

<details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  - **M379a** The cocoon hatched as Omega arrived, and a great dragon rose from it. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "the cocoon hatched even as Omega arrived, and from its midst rose a great dragon."
  - **M379b** Omega and the primal fell together onto Ala Mhigan soil. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "I saw the pair fall motionless from the sky, coming to rest somewhere on Ala Mhigan soil."
  - **M379c** The Domans call the primal Shinryu. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "the Domans were heard to whisper the name … Shinryu"
  - **M379n** The Wall has fallen to the Alliance, as an officer reports to the Viceroy. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "My lord Viceroy—our scouts have confirmed the preliminary reports. Baelsar's Wall has fallen to the Eorzean Alliance."
  - **M379f** Aymeric proposes contacting the Resistance in Gyr Abania. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "I humbly submit that the time has come for us to make contact with the Resistance representatives in Gyr Abania."
  - **M379g** Yda is not Yda: she is Lyse, the fallen Archon's younger sister. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "revealing at last that she is not Yda at all, but the fallen [[Archon]]'s younger sister, [[Lyse]]."
  - **M379i** Yda died six years ago smuggling refugees out of Ala Mhigo. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "Yda died six years ago, on a mission to smuggle refugees out of Ala Mhigo."
  - **M379l** Lyse will continue her family's fight for Ala Mhigo. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "...And I choose to continue my family's fight."
  - **M379p** Zenos expects the coming days to be most interesting. *The Far Edge of Fate* (3.56, main): "Yes...the coming days promise to be most interesting."

</details>
